Hi Jessica — thanks for the note and the timing context. High-level answers upfront:

- UK transfers: We publish a UK Addendum (based on the UK IDTA template) when a customer requests it; signing the EU SCCs alone is often not sufficient for UK data residency/regulatory teams. For customers with UK in-scope regulated data, Finovate will need either the UK Addendum (we can provide) or an explicit contractual reassurance. The Addendum is largely administrative but does include some UK-specific controller-processor clauses.

- Subprocessors/evidence: We maintain a maintained subprocessor manifest and can provide SOC 2 Type II summaries for our primary subprocessors on request. For higher assurance customers we prepare a TIA evidence map (per-subprocessor) that shows which controls/evidence we can supply (SOC2, ISO attestation, contractual flow-downs). We do not typically provide full vendor reports for every subprocessor by default (NDA/secure-share required) but we can provide extracts and/or a signed attestation.

I'll attach the standard DPA w/ SCCs and our current subprocessor manifest for your review; Neha and Karthik are cc'd to confirm expected lead times for the TIA mapping and to flag any operational constraints.

Attachments: redwood-dpa-v3.pdf, subprocessors_manifest_2026-11.csv

Next steps suggested:
- Let us know whether you require a UK Addendum; if yes we'll circulate the draft UK Addendum for signature (can be bundled with the DPA).
- If you want the per-subprocessor TIA map, confirm the scope (all subprocessors vs only those processing UK data) and we'll start the mapping exercise; estimate 7-10 business days to produce an initial draft.

Jessica/Laura — quick technical clarifications from the compliance side:

1) Scope for TIA map: Our default is to map all subprocessors that have access to customer data (see manifest). For Finovate, if you only want those handling UK personal data, tell us the product features you plan to use (hosted API vs dedicated) and we will filter accordingly.

2) Evidence types: For each listed subprocessor we can provide one or more of the following (where available): SOC2 Type II report (summary), ISO27001 certificate, data processing addendum, and a short control mapping stating what logs/traces/retention options exist. Where the subprocessor is a cloud provider (GCP/Azure) we normally provide a link to the compliance center + our internal integration diagram.

3) UK Addendum detail: The UK Addendum we provide mirrors the UK IDTA mandatory modules but we also include a short Schedule that lists processing locations. That Schedule is important for your PCI/privacy counselors — it makes explicit whether UK-only or EU+UK routes are used.

Operational estimate: 7 business days for a filtered TIA map (UK-only subprocessors), 10 business days for a comprehensive per-subprocessor package (with redacted SOC2 summaries). If Finovate requires full reports we will request an NDA/secure transfer and that adds another 3–5 business days.
